definitions.explanation: A practice facility where golfers hit balls into a netted or open field. In Japan, often multi-tiered, with stations along the edge of a city or suburb.
A construction finish in which poured concrete is left visible rather than covered with paint, tile, or other cladding. Often associated with modernist architecture.

notes:
From the pattern verb+っぱなし ("leave Xed; do X and leave as-is"), built on ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to hit; to pour). The two main senses come from two different referents of ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ — hitting balls and pouring concrete.

- {打|う}ちっ{放|ぱな}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the driving range
